ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are four pie charts of percentage composition of land use types, labeled A, B, C, and D respectively. The legend shows that different textures respectively represent cultivated land, forest land, grassland, and other land types. In chart B, forest land accounts for the largest proportion, about 40.6%; the proportion of cultivated land is relatively low, about 15.3%; grassland is about 20.7%, and other is about 23.4%. Then reason: Among the four countries of China, the United Kingdom, India, and Russia, Russia has a vast land area, widespread subarctic coniferous forests, and abundant forest resources, so the proportion of forest land is relatively large; at the same time, affected by high latitude, cold climate, and other factors, the proportion of cultivated land is relatively low. The characteristic of chart B, "high forest land and relatively low cultivated land," best matches Russia.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读取图例，确定乙的各类土地利用比例，重点看到乙的林地比例约40.6%，耕地比例较低约15.3%。再结合题干给出的候选国家：中国、英国、印度、俄罗斯。利用地理常识判断，俄罗斯因国土辽阔、亚寒带针叶林分布广，林地比重大，而耕地比重相对较小。因此乙表示俄罗斯。
